1.title: El-Sayed Apologizes for March Comment About Michigan Synagogue Attack
1.summary: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan, faced criticism from Jewish Democrats after remarking, “hurt people hurt people.”

2.title: Napa County Winery Worker Charged With Starting Pickett Fire That Damaged Grape Harvests
2.summary: The Pickett fire burned nearly 7,000 acres in California wine country last year, causing millions of dollars in losses.

3.title: Relative of Afghans Who Helped U.S. Military Is Deported to Africa
3.summary: The Trump administration has deported thousands of immigrants to countries where they have no ties. Dozens were on the latest flight, to the Central African Republic.

4.title: 37 Killed After Russian Strike on Weapons Depot as Ukraine Blames Negligence
4.summary: The depot, which was in a civilian area near Kyiv, “definitely shouldn’t have been there,” President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

5.title: Carney Has Canadians’ Support on Trump. Now Comes the Hard Part.
5.summary: The U.S.-Canada trade war has galvanized Canadians behind their prime minister’s decision to walk away from negotiations. What happens when the time comes for talks to restart?

6.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos deported from US to UK
6.summary: The self-styled provocateur had been detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
